lines.beaver: 요즘 어떻게 지내요? 얼굴이 좀 피곤해 보여요.
lines.beaver_en: How are you these days? You look a bit tired.
lines.beaver_roman: Yojeum eotteoke jinaeyo? Eolguri jom pigonhae boyeoyo.
lines.learner: 일이 많은 데다가 현실이 힘들어서 지쳤어요.
lines.en: On top of having lots of work, reality is hard, so I'm worn out.
lines.roman: Iri maneun dedaga hyeonsiri himdeureoseo jichyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That must have been hard. But you still have a dream, right?
lines.learner: 네, 저는 아직도 작가가 되는 걸 꿈꿔요.
lines.en: Yes, I still dream of becoming a writer.
lines.roman: Ne, jeoneun ajikdo jakgaga doeneun geol kkumkkwoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 그 꿈을 실현하려면 뭐가 필요해요?
lines.beaver_en: That's nice. What do you need to make that dream real?
lines.beaver_roman: Jonneyo. Geu kkumeul silhyeonharyeomyeon mwoga piryohaeyo?
lines.en: To achieve a dream, you need effort more than a miracle.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 로또 당첨만 기다리는 사람도 많죠.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Many people just wait to win the lottery.
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Rotto dangcheomman gidarineun saramdo manchyo.
lines.learner: 당첨이 돼도 꿈이 없으면 행복하지 않을 거예요.
lines.en: Even if you win, you won't be happy without a dream.
lines.roman: Dangcheomi dwaedo kkumi eopseumyeon haengbokaji aneul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 지금은 어때요? 현실에 안주하고 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: So how about now? Are you settling for reality?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom jigeumeun eottaeyo? Hyeonsire anjuhago isseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, it's comfortable and safe, too. How about you, sunbae?

lines.beaver_en: But my grandfather passed away last year.
lines.learner: 아, 할아버지가 돌아가신 후에 생각이 바뀌셨어요?
lines.en: Oh, did your thinking change after he passed away?
lines.roman: A, harabeojiga doragasin hue saenggagi bakkwisyeosseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네. 일생이 생각보다 짧다는 걸 알았어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes. I realized a lifetime is shorter than we think.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne. Ilsaengi saenggakboda jjaldaneun geol arasseoyo.
lines.en: That's true. No one knows when they'll leave us.

lines.beaver: 그럼 삶에서 가장 소중한 가치는 뭐라고 생각해요?
lines.beaver_en: Then what do you think is the most precious value in life?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom salmeseo gajang sojunghan gachineun mworago saenggakaeyo?
lines.learner: 저한테는 평생 꿈을 꾸는 게 가장 큰 가치예요.
lines.en: For me, dreaming my whole life is the greatest value.
lines.roman: Jeohanteneun pyeongsaeng kkumeul kkuneun ge gajang keun gachiyeyo.

lines.beaver: 멋진 생각이에요. 그럼 이제 뭘 할 거예요?
lines.beaver_en: What a great thought. So what will you do now?
lines.beaver_roman: Meotjin saenggagieyo. Geureom ije mwol hal kkeoyeyo?
lines.learner: 현실에 안주하지 않고 매일 조금씩 글을 쓸 거예요.
lines.en: I won't settle for reality. I'll write a little every day.
lines.roman: Hyeonsire anjuhaji anko maeil jogeumssik geureul sseul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: It'll surely go well. I'll be watching.
lines.learner: 감사해요, 선배. 오늘 정말 큰 힘이 됐어요.
lines.en: Thank you, sunbae. Today really gave me strength.
lines.roman: Gamsahaeyo, seonbae. Oneul jeongmal keun himi dwaesseoyo.
